name: Hensel Mi_ZR_8 enclosure extension frame
aliases: Hensel Mi_ZR_8 enclosure extension frame GA
summary: Mi_ZR_8 enclosure extension frame arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: Mi_ZR_8 is the drawing identifier for enclosure extension frame in Hensel's ENYMOD Mi enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An extension frame forms part of a selected enclosure assembly. Its mating surfaces and the extra interfaces it introduces need to be shown alongside the adjoining enclosure components.

For example, in a distribution enclosure configured with a selected extension frame, use the Mi_ZR_8 reference to coordinate base-to-frame and frame-to-cover interfaces. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Mi_Zwischenrahmen/Mi_ZR_8.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep base-to-frame and frame-to-cover interfaces visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named Mi_ZR_8 drawing and its enclosure extension frame role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
